title: Asymmetric cross-orbital coupling in Fe–Mn spinels decouples structural stability and kinetics in sodium-ion storage
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02934A, Paper
Shuyun Yao, Jingyu Wu, Feike Zhang, Zhiyu Yang, Xiaojiang Yu, Shibo Xi, Qian He, Yao Wu, Zhiqun Lin, Yi-Ming Yan
We show that asymmetric cross-orbital coupling in KxFeyMn1−yOz spinel decouples the trade-off between stability and kinetics. Fe doping induces Mn eg–Fe t2g synergy, boosting both electronic conductivity and structural integrity.
